title: Highlights of Vietnam in 10 days, south to north
summary: Ho Chi Minh City, My Tho or Can Tho, Hoi An, Hue, and Hanoi. Fly once.

days.title: Day 1 — The center
days.body: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and walk the center.

days.title: Day 2 — Palace and War Remnants
days.body: See Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum.

days.title: Day 3 — My Tho or Can Tho
days.body: Take the river day at My Tho, or go on to Can Tho.

days.title: Day 4 — Fly to Da Nang
days.body: Fly to Da Nang. The flight is about 1 hour 20 minutes.

days.title: Day 5 — Hoi An
days.body: Walk the old town from the Japanese Covered Bridge.

days.title: Day 6 — Hoi An or An Bang
days.body: Stay in the old town, or take the An Bang half day.

days.title: Day 7 — Hue
days.body: Travel to Hue and visit the citadel.

days.title: Day 9 — Hanoi
days.body: Travel to Hanoi and walk Hoan Kiem Lake.

days.title: Day 10 — Leave Hanoi
days.body: Keep the last morning in Hanoi and fly home.

seoTitle: Vietnam in 10 days, south to north
seoDescription: Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi in 10 days, with My Tho or Can Tho, Hoi An, and Hue.
